description: See every pull request and issue that needs you, live in the sidebar, on GitHub and Delta, plus optional read-only Gitstream history. Saved lanes are queried live through your gh and dt CLIs, and config and caches stay in bb on your machine. Describe a queue in plain words and bb's configured AI drafts the lane; Focus hides repos everywhere and single items can be hidden too. From any row, start a review or triage thread with Radar's skills attached or rebase your own PR. Optional Context from Slack summarises the public Slack threads that link an item.
